# Windhawk / Start Menu Styler

WinGlow 1.1.0 includes an isolated, unmodified Windhawk runtime. It does not include the module market, editor or compiler, and loads only Start Menu Styler in StartMenuExperienceHost.exe. Existing external Windhawk instances prevent activation rather than being replaced.

- Engine: [Windhawk 1.7.3 release](https://github.com/ramensoftware/windhawk/releases/tag/v1.7.3), [corresponding source and build instructions](https://github.com/ramensoftware/windhawk/tree/v1.7.3).
- Original `windhawk_setup_offline.exe` SHA-256: `4d93016570f982326eebdfc9068e924ff21f6448534ea32672bb4c1d52a8193b`.
- Module: Start Menu Styler 1.7, [source at pinned commit](https://github.com/ramensoftware/windhawk-mods/blob/0bf0b09ddd979fe8a604b1f3099c2ac1e8dfafde/mods/windows-11-start-menu-styler.wh.cpp).
- Official module binary: https://mods.windhawk.net/mods/windows-11-start-menu-styler/1.7_64.dll
- DLL SHA-256: `c116a5388ac8299ca9098e139bddff496ab025d75fe0652f607767904dd89f4d`.
- Included module source SHA-256: `73911e0f8d0619c9b175b492d585e2a11ce3c731bcd1c31b04a976e8a10d6457`.
- `Windhawk-1.7.3-start-menu-1.7.zip` SHA-256: `5ee9b3f448c6a79a1c9b0e8de8cc2381fdcbb389c3642ae33158c84d68db32fe`.

The ZIP includes GPL-3.0 license, LLVM runtime license and the complete module source. Executables, DLLs and runtime DLLs are copied byte-for-byte. Runtime DLLs use the `.whl` filename convention of the upstream compiler. Portable storage configuration is generated by WinGlow; no engine source or binary is modified.

To reproduce: download the exact offline installer and DLL above, extract the installer using 7-Zip into `WinGlow.App/output/integration-sources/windhawk-package`, save the module as `start-menu-1.7-x64.dll` and pinned source as `start-menu.wh.cpp` in that directory's parent, and place the upstream GPL license at `windhawk/LICENSE`. Run `python scripts/Prepare-VisualAssets.py`. ZIP ordering, timestamps and permissions are fixed. A new component version requires a hash update and activation/restore verification.
